text:
- **Ask-tool question closing:** A question can now be answered on the site or in chat. The first answer wins. Questions now close from hook events, not from transcript or rollout reads.
- **Git hook retirement:** pm installs no git hook and no longer sets the hooks path. Session start prepares each new worktree instead.
- **AGENTS.md check stability:** The AGENTS.md check now gives the same verdict on every rerun. Every known-good input passed, and every known-bad input failed, on each rerun.
- **Subagent question ownership:** A question from a subagent now belongs to its parent agent. The owner-request rule now has its own session-start hook.
